data.value: No Input Assigned To This Command!

data.name: ScriptEditor.Help.Intro
data.value: Scripting is very important part of automation. When you need to make two or more events at one time, use script.

data.name: ScriptEditor.Help.Constructor.1
data.value: In visual script constructor you can make script from `blocks`. Every block represent one command.

data.name: ScriptEditor.Help.Constructor.2
data.value: There are pure vMix commands from vMix User Guide, and internal UTC commands, like [Timer] or [Condition].

data.name: ScriptEditor.Help.Constructor.3
data.value: While vMix commands does not affect UTC, with internal commands you can control script flow (conditions and loops available through [GoTo] and [Condition] commands), and update some UTC settings.

data.name: ScriptEditor.Help.CodeEditor.1
data.value: Code editor translate commands from constructor to text representation. You can edit parameters faster, than in visual style of constructor.

data.name: ScriptEditor.Help.CodeEditor.2
data.value: The rule is: one command - one line.

data.name: ScriptEditor.Help.CodeEditor.3
data.value: Start with visual constructor, then switch to code.

data.name: TitleMapping.Help.Line1
data.value: Here you can assign XAML/GT title to widget text field.

data.name: TitleMapping.Help.Line2
data.value: All mapped titles will get same text or image path and will update simultaneously.

data.name: LearnWindow.Label.CloseHint
data.value: or any key to close this window

data.name: Dialog.Warning.PossibleScriptError.Loop
Help.Button.Colorize
data.value: If checked, color parameter applied not only for caption, but also for button body.

data.name: Help.Button.ExecuteAfterLoad
data.value: If checked, button script will be executed right after UTC loaded.

data.name: Help.Button.StateDependent
data.value: If checked, button will show status LED, according to script commands.

data.name: Help.DataSource.Default
data.value: Fill list with data from another widget.

data.name: Help.Hotkeys.Default
data.value: Here you can activate widget hotkeys. Name of the hotkey is self-explanatory. Event will be executed, when user press hotkey into layout panel, while no widget is focused. Link parameter is for calling events from scripts.

data.name: Help.List.Default
data.value: Edit items, that will be shown in widget dropdown list. Put ~ symbol to add description for list item.

data.name: Help.Midi.Default
data.value: Here you can assign MIDI commands to hotkeys in another widgets. Use P as parameter in button script to access fader/knob value.

data.name: Help.SaveTemplate.Default
data.value: Save current widget with properties as template for fast access.

data.name: Help.Scheduler.Default
data.value: Here you can make list of events, that will be executed at specified time and day of the week.

data.name: Help.Script.Default
data.value: Here you can automate some actions, like toggling overlay or sending input to program/preview. Start with one command or create complex scripts with conditions.

data.name: Help.StaticVariables.Default
data.value: Here you can create static variables, accessible from scripts. Variables started from "@" symbol treat as input variables. Input variables are accessible from title mappings and input selector into script command.

data.name: Help.StreamDeck.Default
data.value: Here you can assign StreamDeck commands to hotkeys in another widgets.

data.name: Help.TextField.Table
data.value: If checked, text field of this widget will be working in `table` mode. It means, that all mapped title texts will be shown into text field with `|` delimiter. User can edit one title at time, or replace text in all titles. This option is useful for List Widget.

data.name: DataProvider.Shared.MultipleColumnsByRow.Help
data.value: If checked, data from row treat as UTC table: column1|column2|column3|etc...
